newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada agency lifts WestJet impending suspension.
newsitem.headline: Canada agency lifts WestJet impending suspension.

text.p: Transport Canada, the country's main transportation regulator, said on Monday it lifted WestJet Airlines Ltd's notice of impending suspension.
WestJet, a no-frills western Canadian carrier with four aircraft, voluntarily grounded its fleet two weeks ago after Transport Canada said it was not following approved maintenance procedures.

The agency said Monday WestJet had met conditions it set out on September 17, which included appointing a person to be responsible for aircraft maintenance and implementing a maintenance system that met Transport Canada requirements.

Transport Canada said that since that date, two of the company's planes had been inspected and certified. Similar approvals had still to be given for the other two aircraft before they were allowed to return to the skies, it said. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
